package.description: Generate sequence diagrams from Wireshark PCAP files

en-US.description: Generate sequence diagrams from Wireshark PCAP files
en-US.longDescription: VisualEther converts Wireshark PCAP captures into FDL sequence diagrams using FXT (Field Extraction Template) configuration. It analyzes protocol exchanges and renders them as publication-quality sequence diagrams for protocol documentation and troubleshooting.
en-US.name: VisualEther
